authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A music-themed photograph of a single reference-guided musician performing music during a solo grand-piano rehearsal in a modest recital room. Use the supplied reference for visible facial proportions and the dark chin-length bob with airy fringe. She is absorbed in finishing one flowing phrase, the corners of her mouth gently relaxed and her attention directed along the keyboard. Her quiet personal presence emerges through this concentration and the loose hair catching the light. A simple black knit top and charcoal ankle trousers let the articulation of her arms and legs read clearly. The pianist sits securely on the front half of a padded piano bench, both sitting bones supported by its horizontal seat. Her torso stays balanced above the bench while both shoulders, elbows, wrists and hands form continuous separate chains. Her left fingertips depress keys in the lower register and her right fingertips depress keys in the higher register, with a visible span of unused keys between the two contact groups. The key surfaces immediately around each set of fingertips remain visible. Both hands belong visibly to this one pianist. Her left shoe is planted flat on the wood floor to the left of the pedal assembly. Her right heel rests on the floor and her right forefoot presses the rightmost sustain pedal. The right shoe meets the short front end of that pedal; its exposed brass shaft runs continuously back into the three-pedal lyre. All three separate brass pedals, their common support assembly, the floor contact of both heels, and the side edge of the right shoe meeting the depressed sustain pedal are readable together. The camera views this connection from the pianist's outer right side, across the front of the pedal assembly, so the shoe and pedal meet in a clear side silhouette. Use one landscape photograph from a low right-front three-quarter viewpoint, approximately at bench-seat height, with the keyboard receding diagonally into the scene. Include her face, both key-contact groups, the bench seat and legs, both complete shoes, the entire three-pedal lyre and surrounding floor in the same frame, leaving space below the shoes. Her face is turned slightly toward this open side while her eyes remain on the keys. Soft window light shapes her face and hands; a broad pale reflection illuminates the brass pedals and shoe edges under the piano. Natural color, precise small details, a moderately wide lens and deep focus keep the face, keyboard and low contact geometry legible in one continuous photographic space.
